behavior: Cancel an existing order and publish an order-cancelled integration event.
domainModelNotes: The application layer loads the target order by id.
If the order does not exist, the current implementation throws KeyNotFoundException.
constructorPostconditions: If current status is not Cancelled, status becomes Cancelled and the reason is carried in domain and integration events.
If current status is already Cancelled, no event, persistence, or integration event occurs.
The integration event is staged atomically with the event stream and read model.
